recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖：CD19+ 淋巴球（藍色）CD5 陰性、CD10 陰性、CD20 強陽性，且 kappa/lambda 圖上幾乎全部落在 kappa 象限，呈現 kappa 輕鏈限制性；CD5-/CD10- 單株 B 細胞符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的免疫表型。
features: Multi-panel flow cytometry dot plots on the lymphocyte gate
CD19+ B-cell population (blue) with moderate-bright CD45
B cells negative for CD5 (CD19+CD5+ gate essentially empty) and negative for CD10
Bright CD20 expression on CD19+ cells
Kappa-restricted surface light chain with no lambda-positive B-cell population
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the lymphocyte gate identifies a CD19-positive B-cell population with bright CD20 expression. The B cells lack CD5 and CD10, as shown by essentially empty CD19+CD5+ and CD10+ gates. Surface light-chain analysis shows kappa restriction with no appreciable lambda-positive B cells. These findings indicate a monotypic CD5-negative, CD10-negative B-cell population, which in the context of an IgM paraprotein, lymphoplasmacytic marrow infiltrate and MYD88 L265P is consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma. A plasma-cell gate (CD38/CD138) would further characterize the clonal plasmacytic component.

ddx.vs: MZL shares the CD5-/CD10- kappa- or lambda-restricted phenotype, so distinction needs clinicopathologic and MYD88 correlation.
CLL is CD5+/CD23+ with dim CD20 and dim light chain, unlike this CD5-negative bright CD20 population.
MCL is typically CD5+ and CD23- with cyclin D1 positivity.
FL B cells are CD10 positive, whereas these are CD10 negative.
